block-guide:
CORE/POST-TITLE (Title) Draws the title of the current page or post. The text is the record's title (save-content title), never written in the block. Places: - A Fabrement template frame, above the content slot. A Fabrement template replaces the whole page, so the theme's title is not drawn: without this block the page shows no title. - Inside a Query's post-template: each listed post's title (usually with isLink). MARKUP (comment only; no HTML) level: heading level, DEFAULT 2; the page heading needs "level":1. 0 draws a

. Centered text is style.typography.textAlign (the old textAlign attribute is migrated by the editor). isLink links to the record; linkTarget "_blank" opens a new tab. PITFALLS - A page whose content already opens with its own H1 (a hero) shows two titles under a template with post-title. Give such pages a template without it. - Outside a Query on an archive or the blog index it shows the FIRST listed post's title, not the archive's name: use core/query-title there. - An empty title draws nothing. - In a page's own content it repeats that page's title; the template is the place for it. CHECK Open an assigned page: exactly one H1, with the page's title.
